answerContract.tapInPlace: options hold the snippet's lines, one string per line, in order; picked is the 0-based index of the correct line

archetypes.label: Concept
archetypes.intent: ask which statement about the topic is correct

archetypes.label: Complexity
archetypes.intent: ask for the time or space complexity of a named operation or algorithm

archetypes.label: Which approach
archetypes.intent: ask which approach or technique fits a stated requirement or constraint

archetypes.label: What breaks first
archetypes.intent: ask which component, limit or guarantee fails first as load or scale rises

archetypes.label: Output prediction
archetypes.intent: ask what a given code snippet prints, returns or evaluates to

archetypes.label: Counter-example
archetypes.intent: ask for a case in which a stated rule, claim or approach fails

archetypes.label: Trace the value
archetypes.intent: ask for the value of a named variable or expression at a point in execution

archetypes.label: Failure diagnosis
archetypes.intent: give an observed symptom and ask for its most likely cause

archetypes.label: Threshold
archetypes.intent: ask at what value, scale or condition the right decision changes

archetypes.label: Consequence of a diff
archetypes.intent: state a specific change and ask what it causes

archetypes.label: Estimate
archetypes.intent: ask for an approximate quantity - a size, a rate, a cost or a count

archetypes.label: Missing step
archetypes.intent: give a process or pipeline and ask which required step is absent

archetypes.label: Next step
archetypes.intent: give a situation already reached and ask what should be done next

archetypes.label: Which invariant
archetypes.intent: ask which property must hold for the code or algorithm to be correct

archetypes.label: Which is not true
archetypes.intent: ask which of several statements about the topic is false

archetypes.label: Which test catches it
archetypes.intent: ask which test, input or check would expose a stated defect

archetypes.label: Read the query plan
archetypes.intent: give a query plan and ask what it reveals about execution

archetypes.label: Error cause
archetypes.intent: give an error message or failure output and ask what produced it

archetypes.label: Impossible bound
archetypes.intent: ask which stated bound or result cannot be achieved, and the question must not already state the answer

archetypes.label: Odd one out
archetypes.intent: ask which item does not belong with the others, on a stated shared property

archetypes.label: All that apply
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to mark each listed statement true or false

archetypes.label: Which invariants hold
archetypes.intent: ask which of the listed invariants or guarantees hold in the stated situation

archetypes.label: Sequence
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to put the steps of a process into the order they occur

archetypes.label: Rank by a metric
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to order the items by a single named metric

archetypes.label: Timeline
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to order events by when they happen

archetypes.label: Dependency order
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to order items so each comes after what it depends on

archetypes.label: Interleaving
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to order interleaved operations from several threads or actors

archetypes.label: Term meaning
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to pair each term with its meaning

archetypes.label: Error cause
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to pair each error or symptom with its cause

archetypes.label: Pattern signal
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to pair each signal in a problem with the pattern it suggests

archetypes.label: Operation complexity
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to pair each operation with its complexity

archetypes.label: API guarantee
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to pair each API or setting with the guarantee it provides

archetypes.label: Two-way
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to sort each item into one of two named groups

archetypes.label: Three-way
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to sort each item into one of three named groups

archetypes.label: Which layer
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to assign each item to the layer or tier it belongs to

archetypes.label: Tap the bug
archetypes.intent: give a snippet and ask which line is incorrect

archetypes.label: Tap the bottleneck
archetypes.intent: give code or a design and ask which line or step limits throughput or latency

archetypes.label: Tap the insertion point
archetypes.intent: give a snippet and ask where a stated addition belongs

archetypes.label: Tap the unsafe line
archetypes.intent: give a snippet and ask which line is unsafe under concurrency, untrusted input or failure

archetypes.label: Fill a code blank
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to assemble the missing code from a pool of tokens

archetypes.label: Fill a definition
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to assemble a definition from a pool of tokens

archetypes.label: Fill the signature
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to assemble a method or function signature from a pool of tokens

archetypes.label: Fill the clause
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to assemble a query clause from a pool of tokens

archetypes.label: Flash
archetypes.intent: state one term or fact for the reader to recall and self-rate

archetypes.label: Complexity table
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to tick the cells where each item has each stated complexity or property

archetypes.label: Isolation behaviour
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to tick which anomalies or behaviours each isolation level permits

archetypes.label: Method semantics
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to tick which stated semantics each method or operation has

archetypes.label: Which principle is violated
archetypes.intent: give a design and ask which named design principle it breaks

archetypes.label: Who owns this responsibility
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to assign each responsibility to the class or component that should own it

archetypes.label: Class relationship
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to pair each pair of classes with the relationship between them

archetypes.label: Which metric fits
archetypes.intent: give a task and a constraint and ask which evaluation metric suits it

archetypes.label: Where the data leaks
archetypes.intent: give a data or training pipeline and ask which steps leak information

archetypes.label: Strongest answer
archetypes.intent: give several candidate interview answers and ask which is strongest

archetypes.label: What this answer is missing
archetypes.intent: give one candidate interview answer and ask what is true about its weaknesses

archetypes.label: Your own story
archetypes.intent: ask the reader to write a short answer about their own experience
